regulation: NMC Public Notice on Removal of Names from IMR/NMR 2025
title: Do not present de-registered doctors as registered practitioners
description: NMC removed from the IMR/NMR, by orders dated 14.11.2025, the names of Dr. Muzaffar Ahmad (Reg. 14680/2017), Dr. Adeel Ahmad Rather (Reg. 15892/2019), Dr. Muzamil Shakeel (Reg. 15130/2018) and Dr. Shaheen Saeed (Reg. 45961/2022); content presenting them as registered medical practitioners is non-compliant.

title: Apply IMC 2002 Code of Ethics; 2023 conduct regulations not in force
description: The NMC RMP (Professional Conduct) Regulations 2023 are held in abeyance and are not operative until further Gazette notification. The Indian Medical Council (Professional Conduct, Etiquette and Ethics) Regulations 2002 are adopted and in force with immediate effect, so professional conduct (including advertising) is judged under the 2002 Regulations.

regulation: NMC Guidelines on Professional Responsibilities of Medical Students 2023
title: Do not post patient information on social media
description: Medical students must not indiscriminately post on social media regarding patients and patient-related information, and must maintain confidentiality of information elicited during clinical encounters. Students must introduce themselves as students and avoid giving treatment advice or counselling without due instruction from teachers.

regulation: NMC Guidelines on Professional Responsibilities of Medical Teachers 2023
title: Keep professional boundaries with students on social media
description: Medical teachers must maintain a cordial but professional relationship with students that strictly respects student-teacher boundaries in all interactions, including on social media, and must avoid humiliating students in front of peers or the public.

regulation: NMC Guidelines on Professional Responsibilities of Medical Teachers 2023
title: Follow conduct regulations in dealings with pharma companies
description: Medical teachers must follow the conduct regulations governing interactions with pharmaceutical companies/their representatives and the allied health sector, and must not plagiarise teaching material or falsify/fabricate research data or papers.

regulation: Guidelines for Doctors on Sexual Boundaries 2019 (IPS)
title: Do not exploit doctor-patient relationship for gain
description: Doctors should ensure that they do not exploit the doctor-patient relationship for personal, social, business or sexual gain; this protection extends to patients' family members (Point 11).

regulation: Guidelines for Doctors on Sexual Boundaries 2019 (IPS)
title: Do not enter romantic or sexual relationships with patients
description: The onus is on the doctor not to enter a romantic or sexual relationship with a patient; even 'consensual' activity is a sexual boundary violation, and relationships with former patients are discouraged (at the very least one year after termination of the relationship, with proper hand-over).

regulation: MCI Public Notice on Forged Registration 2014
title: Flag forged or unissued MCI registration numbers
description: MCI declared the registrations claimed by Dr. Sivakumar Subramanian (MCI/09-35642), Dr. Basil Johnson Bosoo (12-42208) and Dr. Sivachandran Guruswamy Pandian (MCI/09-35423) fake and forged, and stated it never issued registration nos. 13-47012, 13-47013, 13-47008, 13-47035, 13-47214, 13-47215, 13-47256 and 13-47255; such persons are not entitled to practise medicine.
